1.explanation:
1. Import the Carbon CSS so you get the default `.bx--btn--ghost.bx--btn--sm { height: 36px; }` rule.
2. Render three buttons: two ghost-style small variants (one using size="small", one using the deprecated small prop) and a normal small secondary button for visual reference.
3. Open your browser DevTools and inspect the ghost buttons. You will see that they are 36px tall instead of the intended 32px height. This reproduces the bug described in the report.
1.bug_scenario: When you render a ghost-style Button with the small variant (either via size="small" or the deprecated small prop), it still measures 36px tall instead of the expected 32px. In DevTools you’ll see the class selectors `.bx--btn--ghost.bx--btn--sm { height: 36px; }` winning over the inline override, resulting in a taller small ghost button.
